title: Unilateral intraosseous lesion with palatal swelling
html: A 24-year-old woman sought treatment for a painless palatal swelling. The swelling had been present for approximately 2 through 3 years and had gradually enlarged, reaching its current size approximately 6 months before she sought treatment. Extraoral examination revealed a slight fullness on the right side of the face. Intraorally, an asymptomatic, pink, firm, well-circumscribed mass measuring 3.5 × 2.8 × 1.8 cm was noted on the right hard palate. The mass extended from the distal aspect of tooth no.
